glosses: A stick or rod used to measure the depth of a liquid. Often used to check the level at which a liquid in an opaque or inaccessible tank or reservoir stands; gauge.

examples.text: I haven't checked the oil level of my car's motor since I lost the dipstick three months ago.

glosses: An exciseman or supervisor who measures with a dipstick.
